flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper} (RD2 reminder candidates, combineNotices, SMS template, sendBatchSms), utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil (APIM Postman2 batch SMS + sms.enable/sms.allowedSources gate), application-{dev,uat,prod}.properties, cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no relevant code for this story
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%), 1 point. The SMS flow for individuals after the 2nd letter exists: candidates with last stage RD2, notices of the same owner combined per stage and due date, the template chosen from the name RD2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL (or _COMBINED), then sent in batches through APIM Postman2 (SmsUtil). Blockers in the repo configuration: (1) cron.notification.enabled=false in prod (manual trigger only); (2) sms.enable=false in dev/uat/prod and sms.allowedSources=ENOTIFICATION only in dev/uat, not in prod, so in prod SmsUtil refuses to send; (3) the number refresh from DataHive is off (cron.enareminder.datahive=false). The SMS template text (whether it refers to the 2nd letter and lists the NOPOs) is in ocms_template_store (DB), cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 says 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate'. Per-environment property values in Azure, the APIM/Postman2 service, DOS and Vault (demo remark): cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Partial claim: the RD2 SMS flow exists in code, but the eNotification cron, SMS sending in prod and the DataHive number refresh are off in the properties; template text in the DB cannot be verified

steps.step: OCMS obtains the latest mobile number of the individual vehicle owner from the data source (DOS)
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and then refreshContactInfo per notice (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188). When enabled, individuals are looked up in DataHive Singpass (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2760) and the new number is written to ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver through updateOcmsContactInfo (:2800-2826). But refreshContactInfo returns immediately with the stored contact when cron.enareminder.datahive is not 'true' (:2461-2476; preload :2325-2333) and that property is false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), so in the repo configuration the latest contact is not fetched. The 'DOS' source in the story versus DataHive in code: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS identifies unique individual vehicle owners and combines their outstanding NOPOs into one SMS
steps.detail: combineNotices groups notices by recipient key (id_no for individuals, UEN for companies, getRecipientKey :2230-2248) + stage + due date, then joins the notice numbers and sums amount_payable (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2151-2227); the notice list reaches the template through combinedNotices and noticeCount (:413-430). Partial because the grouping is per owner + stage + due date combination: an owner with notices on different due dates still receives more than one SMS, not one per owner. FIN/passport holders are treated as individuals (not B).

steps.step: Owners who opted out, hold a passport or have no valid mobile are not sent an SMS
steps.detail: Records on the exclusion list or with id_type P/PASSPORT are skipped before the SMS batch is prepared (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-241); validateContactInfo rejects individuals without phoneNo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2290) and failed records are skipped with a log (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:254-266). The exclusion list content is DB data: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The SMS lists the outstanding NOPOs and refers to the 2nd letter reminder
steps.detail: For reminders the template stage comes from last_processing_stage (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:170-177), so a notice that just passed RD2 uses template RD2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL (or RD2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL_COMBINED when there is more than one notice): determineTemplateName builds the name from stage, channel and recipient type (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:283-301, 459-476), and the data holds noticeNo, combinedNotices, noticeCount, amountPayable, paymentDueDate (:413-430). Partial because the template text lives in ocms_template_store (DB), not in the repo; if the template is missing, the SMS is skipped with an error log. Whether the text refers to the 2nd letter and lists the NOPOs: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The SMS is sent to the vehicle owner in a batch job
steps.detail: The job calls sendBatchSms (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:289-292) which splits records into batches and calls smsUtil.sendBatchSmsSimple with source ENOTIFICATION (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1527-1530, 1611-1612) through APIM. Partial for three reasons: (1) cron.notification.enabled=false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), manual trigger only; (2) sms.enable=false in prod (application-prod.properties:87) and sms.allowedSources is not set in prod (only ENOTIFICATION in dev/uat), so SmsUtil refuses to send (SmsUtil.java:401-410); (3) notification.sms.enabled=true does not help because the SmsUtil gate sits deeper (application.properties:176). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 says 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate'. The APIM/Postman2 service, SMS permission for the api server (demo remark) and Vault: cannot verify from repo.
